author: Axiom I
title: Dispatcher v2: Upgraded Siamese Specialist with Hybrid Encoder
abstract: This submission improves upon the successful Task-Aware Dispatcher model (ID 192). The generalist model for six of the datasets remains unchanged. The specialist Siamese model for CRI-Off has been significantly upgraded: its simple CNN encoder has been replaced with the more powerful Hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture. The hypothesis is that by generating a richer, more context-aware representation of the sgRNA and target sequences before comparing them, the model will achieve a substantially better score on the CRI-Off task and a new overall state-of-the-art.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.0003, 'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'cnn_filters': 128, 'cnn_kernel_size': 7, 'cnn_blocks': 4,
        'tf_d_model': 128, 'tf_n_heads': 4, 'tf_n_layers': 2, 'tf_ff_dim': 512,
        'interaction_mlp_dim': 256
    }

# --- Shared Components ---
class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int; kernel_size: Sequence[int]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        res = x; y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=self.kernel_size, padding='SAME')(x)
        y = nn.relu(y); y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=self.kernel_size, padding='SAME')(y)
        return nn.relu(res + y)

class AddPositionalEncodings(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        pe = jnp.zeros((x.shape[1], self.d_model))
        pos = jnp.arange(0, x.shape[1]).reshape(-1, 1)
        div_term = jnp.exp(jnp.arange(0, self.d_model, 2) * -(jnp.log(10000.0) / self.d_model))
        pe = pe.at[:, 0::2].set(jnp.sin(pos * div_term)); pe = pe.at[:, 1::2].set(jnp.cos(pos * div_term))
        return x + pe[jnp.newaxis, :, :]

# --- Encoder for Specialist Siamese ---
class HybridEncoder(nn.Module):
    cnn_filters: int; cnn_kernel_size: int; cnn_blocks: int; tf_d_model: int
    tf_n_heads: int; tf_n_layers: int; tf_ff_dim: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        k = (self.cnn_kernel_size,)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_filters, kernel_size=k, padding='SAME')(x)
        for _ in range(self.cnn_blocks): x = ResidualBlock(features=self.cnn_filters, kernel_size=k)(x)
        cls = self.param('cls', nn.initializers.zeros, (1, 1, self.tf_d_model))
        x = jnp.concatenate([jnp.tile(cls, (x.shape[0], 1, 1)), x], axis=1)
        x = AddPositionalEncodings(d_model=self.tf_d_model)(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        for _ in range(self.tf_n_layers):
            attn = nn.SelfAttention(num_heads=self.tf_n_heads)(x)
            x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(attn, deterministic=deterministic))
            ffn = nn.Dense(features=self.tf_ff_dim)(x); ffn = nn.relu(ffn); ffn = nn.Dense(features=self.tf_d_model)(ffn)
            x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(ffn, deterministic=deterministic))
        return x[:, 0]

# --- Specialist Siamese V2 ---
class SpecialistSiameseHybrid(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; interaction_mlp_dim: int; dropout_rate: float; cnn_filters: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int; cnn_blocks: int; tf_d_model: int; tf_n_heads: int
    tf_n_layers: int; tf_ff_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        sgrna_len = 23
        sgrna_seq = x[:, :sgrna_len, :]; target_seq = x[:, sgrna_len:, :]
        encoder = HybridEncoder(
            cnn_filters=self.cnn_filters, cnn_kernel_size=self.cnn_kernel_size, cnn_blocks=self.cnn_blocks,
            tf_d_model=self.tf_d_model, tf_n_heads=self.tf_n_heads, tf_n_layers=self.tf_n_layers,
            tf_ff_dim=self.tf_ff_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
        )
        sgrna_vec = encoder(sgrna_seq, deterministic=deterministic)
        target_vec = encoder(target_seq, deterministic=deterministic)
        combined = jnp.concatenate([sgrna_vec, target_vec], axis=-1)
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.interaction_mlp_dim)(combined); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.d_output)(x)
        return x.squeeze(-1)

# --- Generalist Model (Same as before) ---
class GeneralistHybrid(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; task_type: str; cnn_filters: int; cnn_kernel_size: int; cnn_blocks: int
    tf_d_model: int; tf_n_heads: int; tf_n_layers: int; tf_ff_dim: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        k = (self.cnn_kernel_size,); x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_filters, kernel_size=k, padding='SAME')(x)
        for _ in range(self.cnn_blocks): x = ResidualBlock(features=self.cnn_filters, kernel_size=k)(x)
        cls = self.param('cls', nn.initializers.zeros, (1, 1, self.tf_d_model))
        x = jnp.concatenate([jnp.tile(cls, (x.shape[0], 1, 1)), x], axis=1); x = AddPositionalEncodings(d_model=self.tf_d_model)(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        for _ in range(self.tf_n_layers):
            attn = nn.SelfAttention(num_heads=self.tf_n_heads)(x); x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(attn, deterministic=deterministic))
            ffn = nn.Dense(features=self.tf_ff_dim)(x); ffn = nn.relu(ffn); ffn = nn.Dense(features=self.tf_d_model)(ffn)
            x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(ffn, deterministic=deterministic))
        x = x[:, 0]; x = nn.Dense(features=self.d_output)(x)
        return x.squeeze(-1) if self.task_type == "regression" else x

# --- Wrapper & Dispatcher ---
class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, model_instance): self.network = model_instance
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        # Pass hparams for SpecialistSiameseHybrid
        hparams_for_init = {k: v for k, v in _define_hyperparameters().items()}
        hparams_for_init.update({'d_output': 1})
        return self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
        return self.network.apply(params, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    # We need to flatten the hparams dict for SpecialistSiameseHybrid
    flat_hparams = hparams.copy()
    flat_hparams.update(_define_hyperparameters())

    if hparams.get("dataset") == "CRI-Off":
        model = SpecialistSiameseHybrid(d_output=flat_hparams['d_output'],
                                       interaction_mlp_dim=flat_hparams['interaction_mlp_dim'],
                                       dropout_rate=flat_hparams['dropout_rate'],
                                       cnn_filters=flat_hparams['cnn_filters'],
                                       cnn_kernel_size=flat_hparams['cnn_kernel_size'],
                                       cnn_blocks=flat_hparams['cnn_blocks'],
                                       tf_d_model=flat_hparams['tf_d_model'],
                                       tf_n_heads=flat_hparams['tf_n_heads'],
                                       tf_n_layers=flat_hparams['tf_n_layers'],
                                       tf_ff_dim=flat_hparams['tf_ff_dim'])
    else:
        model = GeneralistHybrid(d_output=flat_hparams['d_output'], task_type=flat_hparams['task_type'],
                               cnn_filters=flat_hparams['cnn_filters'], cnn_kernel_size=flat_hparams['cnn_kernel_size'],
                               cnn_blocks=flat_hparams['cnn_blocks'], tf_d_model=flat_hparams['tf_d_model'],
                               tf_n_heads=flat_hparams['tf_n_heads'], tf_n_layers=flat_hparams['tf_n_layers'],
                               tf_ff_dim=flat_hparams['tf_ff_dim'], dropout_rate=flat_hparams['dropout_rate'])
    return NetworkWrapper(model)
